analytics.methodology: 20 warm GET trials grouped by generation; 20 explicitly requested full projection rebuilds, each followed by GET. Two waves of four concurrent GETs. Full rebuild is not automatic TTL/incremental refresh. Derived projection/audit writes only; business fixture untouched.
analytics.failure: Analytics probe stopped on unexpected status/latency
analytics.stopReason: Stopped on first 409 ANALYTICS_REFRESH_CONFLICT; no POST retry. Incomplete refresh latency experiment, not a passing 20-sample result.

generationCohorts.note: Generation-change timing does not isolate TTL refresh from a concurrent scheduler publication. Client timestamp age is descriptive and can contain clock skew.

warmFollowup.methodology: Independent GET-only cohort after the stopped rebuild experiment: initial GET then 20 reads required to stay on that generation; all latency retained. No POST retry. Session writes only; GET may refresh derived projections if stale.

fixtureVerification.basis: The same initialized operator fixture configuration was reused; authoritative before/after database snapshots verify the selected booking ID and all fifteen business-table count/digests.
fixtureVerification.timingReceiptLimitation: Timing receipts did not serialize config.fixture; parameter-redacted request logs do not independently identify each booking parameter. Do not treat absent timing-receipt fields as a successful fixture assertion.

retention.source: Operator via existing IPv4 pooler for the same project/database; runtime uses direct IPv6 endpoint. Not container RTT.

predeploy.note: Service configuration included predeploy probe, but no independently identifiable result was captured. Runtime-container result below supplies the actual endpoint proof; predeploy execution is not inferred from SUCCESS.

operatorExperiment.method: Six alternating pairs, 12s idle gap, max=1 per pool, operator-only connect timeout 8s, read-only transactions only. Runtime acquisition budget is unchanged.
